messages:
jen (People Ops): Quick heads up — remote all-hands starting in 12m. Agenda tweak: leadership updates first, then product roadmap, Q&A at the end. Pinning deck link now.

matt (Eng): on my way. Is the stream recording URL still the same? last time recording didn't save.

ops-bot: Recording scheduled: allhands-2026-03-23.mp4 — auto-start in 10m.

sophia (Product): Can we confirm product roadmap bullets for the Q&A? I need one slide added about Dedicated features and the new batching recommendations.

jen (People Ops): @sophia yep — sent updated deck v3 to #docs. @matt stream will be on rtv.redwood.ai/live — but @derek can confirm recording path and fallback.

derek (Infra): Seeing encoder (us-east-1) heartbeat jitter. I'm rolling to backup encoder now. If you notice stutter, hit the emergency mute and I'll switch source.

matt (Eng): Copy. For presenters: use wired mic, set sample rate to 48k, avoid virtual backgrounds — they triggered CPU spikes last time.

katie (Marketing): Can we open the Q&A queue in Slido? Need to capture questions for highlight clips after.

jen (People Ops): Slido link posted. Also adding a separate bucket for marketing clips.

sophia (Product): Quick leadership Q to add to the queue: Will Dedicated SLOs include 99th percentile token latency guarantees? I'll ask during Q&A.

jen (People Ops): added to the Q&A board — @sophia.

matt (Eng): Encoder switch complete. Running a short health check.
matt (Eng): test clip: ```ffmpeg -i rtmp://encoder/s1 -t 5 -c copy /tmp/test.mp4``` worked locally, ffprobe shows no frame drops.

ops-bot: Presenter access granted: @jen, @sophia, @matt.

derek (Infra): If recording still fails we'll fallback to Zoom cloud recording and stitch later. I'll monitor the stream and encoder logs.

alex (CEO): Running about 3 mins behind — please compress slides to top highlights. We'll keep Q&A open but shorten the non-critical slides.

sophia (Product): Copy. Trimming roadmap slide to bullets.

katie (Marketing): :thumbsup: prepping social clip timestamps once recording is confirmed.

matt (Eng): Noticed a tiny mic stutter at 0:02-0:04 on the test. @derek, can you check the XLR/USB routing?

derek (Infra): Swapping XLR cable and re-clocking the interface. New test looks clean. No more jitter on ingest.

jen (People Ops): OK team, green across the board. Recording starts in ~2m. Last call for leadership Qs here and we'll queue them.

sophia (Product): One more: any update on the private deployment compliance timeline? leadership will we get a short update?

alex (CEO): We'll cover compliance roadmap in the first 10 mins. Teams that need deeper follow-ups, please schedule a follow-up sync after the all-hands.

jen (People Ops): Reminder: attendees are muted on entry. Use reactions (:raised_hand:) to queue questions. We'll pull high-priority ones into live Q&A.

matt (Eng): Good luck everyone — go time :rocket:

katie (Marketing): Recording started and health checks look stable. I'll flag timestamps for clips as we go.

jen (People Ops): Thanks — closing thread for live updates. If anything critical pops, ping #oncall and I'll repost here.
